articles.title: Amazon offers agentic shoppers up to 365 days of price history
articles.summary: Amazon expanded its Alexa for Shopping assistant to show 30, 90, and 365 days of price history directly on product pages, alongside existing agentic features like auto-buying at a target price. The rollout continues Amazon's push to have its AI shopping layer handle more of the buying decision, not just product discovery.
articles.tieback: For dropship and 3P sellers, this raises the bar on how fast and accurately supplier pricing and inventory data needs to sync back to marketplace listings, since stale price or stock data now gets surfaced directly to AI-assisted shoppers.

articles.title: Adyen on Agentic Commerce: The AI Was Never the Hard Part
articles.summary: Adyen's global head of agentic commerce, Karan Katyal, told PYMNTS the industry sits at 0.5 on a five-point maturity scale and will roughly triple activity in the next year. He said the real bottleneck isn't the AI itself but the infrastructure underneath it: machine-readable product catalogs, fragmented protocols, and unresolved questions about fraud and liability when an agent transacts on a shopper's behalf.
articles.tieback: The catalog and trust gap Katyal describes is exactly where automated EDI and real-time order and inventory visibility matter most, since an agent can't transact against a supplier's product data if that data isn't structured, current, and machine-readable in the first place.

articles.title: How AI Erased a $184 Billion Supply Chain Blind Spot
articles.summary: C.H. Robinson's new Lean AI Engineer tool assesses an entire supply chain in under 30 minutes and acts on inefficiencies in real time, replacing a process that used to take four weeks of backward-looking analysis. Annual supply chain disruption costs of $184 billion are driven less by the disruptions themselves than by the lag between spotting a problem and acting on it.
articles.tieback: This is the same lag that real-time order and inventory visibility plus intelligent routing and supplier analytics are built to close, turning weeks of backward-looking reporting into an operational feed suppliers and retailers can act on immediately.

articles.title: The top supply chain stress sources include…
articles.summary: A new Inspectorio survey of nearly 200 supply chain professionals found compliance strain rising while budgets flatten, with only 21% of organizations having a multi-tier traceability strategy. Inspectorio's CEO said the biggest obstacle to effective AI adoption isn't the technology, it's insufficient data quality, change management gaps, and lack of cross-functional integration.
articles.tieback: That data quality bottleneck is a direct argument for rapid, standardized vendor onboarding and automated EDI, since AI initiatives stall when supplier and compliance data arrives fragmented or in inconsistent formats.

articles.title: AI Is Changing How Customers Choose Your Business
articles.author: Graham Kenny and Ganna Pogrebna
articles.summary: Graham Kenny and Ganna Pogrebna argue that as AI increasingly mediates how business customers research and choose suppliers, competitive advantage is shifting from direct customer understanding to managing how AI systems represent a company. They cite three companies that adapted by screening AI-generated inquiries, monitoring how AI tools describe their business, and replacing periodic reviews with continuous monitoring of AI-generated market perceptions.
articles.tieback: For B2B sellers on marketplaces, this reinforces the case for a transactionable presence on LLMs and agents, since suppliers not structured for AI-mediated discovery risk being screened out before a buyer ever sees their catalog.

articles.title: Visa Payments Forum in Paris: Agentic Commerce is Coming
articles.author: Natalia Elliot
articles.summary: At its Payments Forum in Paris, Visa announced that AI agents can now search, select, and initiate purchases on merchant websites across Europe using its Intelligent Commerce infrastructure, working with 30 European issuers and merchants including lastminute.com and Frasers. Visa also expanded Visa Agentic Ready to merchants through a new Trusted Agent Protocol and Agent Directory, and said the same model will extend to B2B payment scenarios.
articles.tieback: As payment networks build the rails for agents to transact directly with individual merchants, suppliers whose product, price, and inventory data isn't clean and real-time will be invisible to the agent at the exact moment it's ready to buy.

articles.title: Square Intros ChatGPT and Claude Integrations for Sellers
articles.summary: Square launched a ChatGPT app and Claude plugin that let merchants get discovered and take orders directly inside AI conversations, starting with food and beverage sellers on Square Online Ordering, with automatic enrollment and no added fees. Square is also extending AI-powered discovery to voice commerce through a partnership with Amazon's Alexa+.
articles.tieback: Square's zero-setup approach lowers the bar for showing up inside agent conversations, raising the stakes for suppliers that still can't connect accurate inventory and order data fast enough to participate.

articles.title: Brands focus agentic AI on lower-level customer experience workflows
articles.summary: An Infobip 2026 Customer Experience Maturity Report found 53% of global brands have adopted agentic AI for lower-value tasks like feedback collection and reminders, but adoption drops sharply for higher-value workflows such as loyalty management (35%), delivery management (28%), and returns and refunds (15%). Infobip's chief revenue officer attributes the gap to fragmented systems rather than a lack of appetite for deeper automation.
articles.tieback: The steep drop-off in agentic AI adoption for delivery management and returns tracks directly to fragmented order and inventory data, the gap that real-time order and inventory visibility is built to close.

articles.title: Amazon invests $1 billion to embed AI engineers with clients
articles.summary: AWS is committing $1 billion to a new Forward Deployed Engineering unit that embeds engineering teams directly inside customer organizations to build and deploy production agentic AI systems in weeks rather than months. Amazon frames it as a break from traditional consulting, with customers left owning both the finished system and the in-house skills to extend it.
articles.tieback: As cloud providers race to shrink the time between deciding to deploy AI and having it live in production, the retailers who benefit most will be the ones whose supplier and inventory data is already clean enough for an embedded engineering team to build on.

articles.title: EXCLUSIVE: The top CPG retailer fulfillment pain points are...
articles.summary: A Dynata survey of 50 CPG retail executives conducted for Radial found 48% cite technology integrations and data visibility as their top fulfillment pain point, ahead of e-commerce fulfillment speed (38%) and routing guide compliance and chargebacks (30%). Two-thirds of respondents said it's highly important that a single 3PL partner handle both retail replenishment and e-commerce fulfillment, and 30% named EDI integration a required 3PL capability.
articles.tieback: Technology integration and data visibility topping the pain point list is a direct match for what automated EDI and real-time order and inventory visibility are built to fix in a CPG-heavy fulfillment conversation.

articles.title: Inside AI's $5 trillion quest to give agentic AI a sense of taste
articles.author: Elizabeth Segran
articles.summary: Shopping agents from OpenAI, Google and Anthropic can browse and compare products but still struggle to match people with brands that fit their taste, since large language models lack the aesthetic judgment behind most real purchase decisions. The piece traces the plumbing being built for agentic commerce, including OpenAI and Stripe's Agentic Commerce Protocol and Google and Shopify's Universal Commerce Protocol, and notes that checkout inside AI chat still stumbles on inventory and personalization gaps.
articles.tieback: Agentic checkout only works if the AI can see accurate, real-time product and inventory data, the same data layer Logicbroker's real-time order and inventory visibility and transactionable LLM presence are built to supply.

articles.title: Square launches agentic commerce integrations with ChatGPT, Claude
articles.summary: Square rolled out a ChatGPT app and a Claude plugin that let food and beverage sellers on Square Online Ordering get discovered and take orders directly inside those AI assistants, with no new contracts or marketplace commissions beyond standard processing fees. Square is also joining the AAIF Agentic Commerce Working Group and partnering with Google on the Universal Commerce Protocol for local ordering and delivery.
articles.tieback: AI assistants are becoming a real order channel that small and mid-size merchants need to plug into, the same transactionable presence on LLMs and agents that Logicbroker is building toward for its supplier network.

articles.title: EXCLUSIVE: The top CPG retailer fulfillment pain points are...
articles.summary: A Dynata survey of 50 CPG retail executives, commissioned by Radial, found that 48% cite technology integrations and data visibility as their top fulfillment pain point, ahead of DTC fulfillment speed (38%) and routing guide compliance and chargebacks (30%). More than half of respondents also said their 3PL needs to integrate with Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Amazon Seller/Vendor Central and Shopify, while only 30% flagged EDI integration specifically.
articles.tieback: Technology integration gaps and routing guide chargebacks are exactly what automated EDI and real-time order and inventory visibility are built to eliminate, making this survey a direct read on the pain Logicbroker sells against.

articles.title: Digital twins, software maturity lead manufacturing automation trends
articles.author: Nathan Owens and Katie Pyzyk
articles.summary: At the Automate conference, speakers described engineers using large language models through an MCP-style agent interface to pull technical specs and quotes for faster, smarter robot simulation. They also warned that AI still requires per-process configuration and that finance teams want quality and risk cases, not headcount savings, before greenlighting automation spend.
articles.tieback: The same MCP-style pattern that lets an AI agent pull structured technical data on demand is the model Logicbroker applies to supplier analytics and intelligent routing across a dropship network.

articles.title: 4 experts on how to make AI investments worthwhile
articles.author: Bryan Wassel
articles.summary: Leaders at Customer Contact Week Las Vegas warned that AI vendors often oversell capabilities that add friction instead of value, and urged buyers to understand the true cost to scale before signing on and to judge vendors on long-term reliability rather than a polished demo. They also stressed that any AI rollout has to start from what customers actually want, not from what the technology can technically do.
articles.tieback: The advice to weigh a vendor's long-term reliability and real cost to scale over a slick demo is a useful lens for retailers evaluating any AI-driven commerce platform, including one built for dropship and marketplace onboarding.
